shots.action: Driver (infected) clamped on the junior's left shoulder at the neck, junior screaming with the round mouth; Kong's two black gloves and the orange cutter body drive in from screen right. Continues the hook's S23 attack loop, feet planted in the `lunge` stance.

shots.action: Kong's wrist: black glove cuff, orange sleeve edge, a square rescue watch strapped over the cuff. Analogue face, nothing to read but one red second hand; a drop of the junior's blood sits on the 12 mark, where the hand stood at the bite. The hand is at the 2 (10 s gone, 50 to go round to the blood) and sweeps on; rain drops land and run on the glass; the wrist jolts with the shove.

shots.action: Driver slams back-first into the flank of a white hatchback in the next lane; the car rocks on its springs; he slides down, already twisting to get up. Extras far behind run right.

shots.action: Low from the road: a rider in a green jacket and white helmet runs left to right over the roofs of the jam, two lanes behind the truck; in the foreground the junior's head snaps up toward the noise of his boots.

shots.action: James on the roofs, run cycle with every footfall planted on a roof panel, one long step across a gap between cars; terrified face over his shoulder. No delivery box: it lies on the deck where the hook left it.

shots.action: The junior springs onto a bonnet, then a roof (crouch, lunge, crouch on twos) and goes after the rider, left to right. The rider drops out of sight behind the bus; the junior stops on a roof, head hunting (rule 7). The space behind the truck is empty.

shots.action: Kong steps out from the corner; head turns left to right across the frame (`alarmed`), red then blue on his wet face. No words.

shots.action: Big wide down the expressway: about twenty figures (the ten extras roles and back-lit repeats) running between the cars, left to right, seen from the waist up over the bonnets so no foot contact is drawn; doors open, an umbrella rolling; two faster figures vault bonnets side-on. Beacons, hazards, sodium, the skyline.
